data_policy.content_storage: factual game discovery metadata and short section evidence labels only
data_policy.rights_note: Public visibility alone does not establish republication rights. No full descriptions, images, videos or game assets stored.

source.ui_language_observed: Chinese UI with English game titles and genres

scope.sampling_rule: First 10 game cards in section in accessibility DOM order. Skip non-game create promotion; preserve separate section memberships.

source_extensions.section_definition_raw: 过去 24 小时内玩家数量增幅最大

limitations: Not a complete catalog, official rank, representative sample or independently measured heat score.
One snapshot does not measure growth, velocity, retention or trends.
Plays and likes have no observed accumulation period; do not assume 24-hour or lifetime totals.
Abbreviated counts are approximate; missing values are not zero.
Current authenticated access was verified after settling; future login persistence is not guaranteed.
Browser compatibility warning remained but discovery metadata was readable.
Only general discovery cards collected; no account identity, history, profile links, email, secrets, personal recommendations or assets stored.
Same games may occur in both batches; deduplicate by identity_key only for entity counts, not section observations.
